decisions.reason: As a 2018 launch close to the core offer and already given its own web page, it reflects visible commitment and recent investment that management would be reluctant to abandon so soon in a growing market.
This automation product builds directly on the firm's established systems and announced growth direction, so management would justify continued support by treating any early shortfall as temporary.
Although only mentioned briefly on the website, it is a recent product close to the existing formwork business, making continuation the more likely choice under escalation of commitment.
Its own product page signals public commitment, and because it fits the firm's modular formwork portfolio management would tend to persist rather than reverse course after only one year.
The firm has visibly backed this product and it sits near the technological center of the existing offer, so sunk development effort and strategic fit both favor keeping it.

Even with lower website prominence, it is a fresh 2018 extension of the core magnetic formwork line, and management in an expanding R&D-oriented firm would likely keep it on the market longer before conceding failure.
